description: The plot illustrates layer-group–wise relative change (in percent) for several token/precision configurations compared against a baseline, with each configuration shown as a separate line across five layer ranges. The x-axis is categorical with the label positions “Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32,” evenly spaced. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from −15% up to 5%, with regularly spaced tick labels at 5% intervals (−15%, −10%, −5%, 0%, 5%). A gray dashed horizontal reference line labeled “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit” lies at 0% across all layer groups. The “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit” series is a solid yellow line with circular markers, starting near 0% at Layer1-4, dipping to about −1% at Layer5-12, returning to about 0% at Layer13-20, sitting slightly below 0% (around −0.5%) at Layer21-28, and ending slightly above 0% (around +0.5%) at Layer29-32. The “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit” series is a solid light-blue line with circular markers, near 0% (slightly negative) at Layer1-4, around −2.5% at Layer5-12, reaching its lowest point near −6% at Layer13-20, rising to around −4% at Layer21-28, and ending around −1% at Layer29-32. The “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit” series is a solid red line with square markers, starting just above 0% at Layer1-4, dropping to about −2.5% at Layer5-12, moving to around −2% at Layer13-20, staying near −2% at Layer21-28, and ending near 0% (slightly negative) at Layer29-32. The “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit” series is a solid dark-blue line with square markers, starting around −1% at Layer1-4, decreasing to about −5.5% at Layer5-12, reaching its minimum near −14.5% at Layer13-20, rising to about −11% at Layer21-28, and ending around −1.5% at Layer29-32.
